necessary_context.content: Finite-dimensional real inner-product spaces X,Y; continuous linear K:X->Y, L=||K||; G and F* proper convex lower-semicontinuous nonnegative functions, with F* the convex conjugate of convex lower-semicontinuous F. S(x,y)=<Kx,y>+G(x)-F*(y). A saddle-point exists and satisfies K xhat in partial F*(yhat), -K* yhat in partial G(xhat). The displayed codomain on PDF p.4 is [0,+infinity); no extension beyond the source Model is asserted.
necessary_context.name: Saddle-point Model

necessary_context.content: prox_{a H}(v)=(I+a partial H)^(-1)(v)=argmin_u {||u-v||^2/(2a)+H(u)}. The paper assumes simple resolvents, mentioning closed forms or high-precision numerical solutions. The selected mathematical guarantee uses the exact resolvent equations; numerical error tolerance is not supplied by Theorem 1.
necessary_context.locator: §2, PDF p.5 / printed p.3, resolvent definition and Eq.(6)
necessary_context.name: Resolvent and available operations

necessary_context.content: The source defines the partial gap using max over B2 and min over B1. For bounded nonempty effective-domain test sets, the extracted statement uses sup/inf, allowing nonattainment without assuming compactness. Nonnegativity is used only when the test product contains a saddle-point. No characterization of all zero-gap pairs is extracted.
necessary_context.name: Restricted gap
